description: Source code for the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 Message class, providing methods to convert HTTP messages to string, parse messages, generate summaries, and handle message bodies.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for handling HTTP messages, including serialization, parsing, and body management.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an HTTP message into its string representation.

methods.name: bodySummary
methods.description: Returns a short, printable summary of the message body, or null if not printable.

methods.name: rewindBody
methods.description: Rewinds the message body stream, throwing an exception if it cannot be rewound.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Parses an HTTP message string into an associative array with start-line, headers, and body.

methods.name: parseRequestUri
methods.description: Constructs a URI for an HTTP request based on the path and headers.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses a request message string into a RequestInterface object.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a response message string into a ResponseInterface object.
